cohort: All 42 public facilities designated to provide EmONC in 3 health zones in North Kivu Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo
finding: The availability, use, and quality of EmONC in post-conflict North Kivu Province, DRC, fell short of WHO standards, highlighting the need for improved maternal and newborn health services.
mod_finding: Assisted vaginal delivery was the least performed signal function of EmONC, followed by parenteral administration of anticonvulsants, mainly due to policy restrictions and lack of demand.
